verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference runtime with an OpenAI-compatible serve mode, so concurrency capacity is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never mentions reserving dedicated capacity, request batching, or keeping throughput steady under concurrent agents or sessions. The +59% decode throughput claim comes from expert prefetching, and 'one read-only base serves multiple adapter sets' is about adapter sharing; neither addresses concurrent-request capacity, so neither is credited.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the runtime reserves dedicated capacity so throughput holds steady when multiple agents or sessions issue requests concurrently
